_comment: An instrument must run its own instrument. Before the evidence-instrument rules these scripts classified as unknown_runtime_surface, so a change to the wasm parity checker selected only format, lint, typecheck, unit and build - never wasm_parity. The check could be weakened in the same change it was supposed to measure. 'high' confidence is what pins the classification: an unknown file forces confidence to low, so this fails if the rule is ever removed.
